title: Tangan Yang Menadah
subject: hands raised in prayer at dawn
caption: Nasyid-influenced Malay pop. Almost entirely voices and percussion: frame drums and hand claps keep the pulse, with a soft bass entering only in the final section and no melodic instruments elsewhere. A male solo lead is answered by a group singing in close four-part harmony, building to a full stacked chorus. Wide stereo image, long cavernous reverb tails as if in a hall. 80 BPM, D major. Devotional, rising, calm.
lyrics:
[Intro - Frame Drums]

[Verse 1 - solo]
Subuh ni sejuk lagi
Jalan masih gelap sikit
Aku jalan sendiri
Tapi aku tak rasa sendiri

[Pre-Chorus - group]
(Menadah) menadah
(Menadah) menadah

[Chorus - group harmony]
Tangan yang menadah
Tak pernah balik kosong
Walaupun yang datang
Bukan yang aku minta

[Verse 2 - solo]
Aku pernah minta banyak
Aku pernah dapat sikit
Sekarang aku baru faham
Sikit tu pun jawapan

[Bridge - group]
(Alhamdulillah) alhamdulillah
(Alhamdulillah) alhamdulillah

[Chorus - full stacked]
Tangan yang menadah
Tak pernah balik kosong
Walaupun yang datang
Bukan yang aku minta

[Outro]
Menadah
Menadah
